# Earnings Hub and Calendar. ## About this app. Earnings Hub is designed for investors to quickly stay on top of everything related to stock earnings, earnings calls, news, earnings reports, and quarterly calls. - Listen to LIVE Earnings Calls. - Listen to Past Earnings Calls. Safety starts with understanding how developers collect and share your data. The developer provided this information and may update it over time. This app may collect these data types. As a swing trader tracking several hundred stocks, this app is invaluable. I use it to track earnings releases and sell before each one to avoid the off-hours collapses. The app is well written, intuitive, and easy to use. however, the site has taken a significant step back....specifically bc I spend the majority of my time trying to close/block Ads. therefore, I had to find an alternative...and i'm happy i found Earnings Hub. it is reliable, user friendly, easy to navigate, fast, etc.
